  if (bar.childElementCount !== n) bar.innerHTML = '<i></i>'.repeat(n);
  [...bar.children].forEach((e, j) => e.classList.toggle('on', j === k));
}
const restThumb = b => showThumb(b, b.dataset.step != null ? +b.dataset.step : Infinity);
function thumbs() {
  if (thumbsMade || !overview) return; thumbsMade = true;
  const fit = new ResizeObserver(es => es.forEach(e => e.target.style.setProperty('--thumb-scale', e.contentRect.width / 1280)));
  overview.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach((b, i) => {
    const s = slides[i].cloneNode(true);
    s.classList.add('active'); s.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
    copies.set(b, partsOf(s));
    s.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f => {
      f.loading = 'lazy'; f.tabIndex = -1;
      frameReady(f).then(() => {
        const a = anim(f); if (!a) return;
        a.setVisible?.(true); restThumb(b);
        return Promise.resolve(a.settled).then(() => passRatio(f));
      });
    });
    const view = document.createElement('div'); view.className = 'thumb-view'; view.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    const reveal = document.createElement('div'); reveal.className = 'reveal';
    const copy = document.createElement('div'); copy.id = 'stage'; copy.className = 'slides';
    const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'thumb-steps';
    copy.append(s); reveal.append(copy); view.append(reveal, bar); b.prepend(view); fit.observe(view);
    restThumb(b);
  });
}
overview?.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.thumb'); if (!b) return;
  const n = maxStep(+b.dataset.index) + 1; if (n < 2) return;
  const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(), k = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * n)));
  if (b.dataset.step !== String(k)) { b.dataset.step = k; showThumb(b, k); }
});
overview?.addEventListener('pointerout', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.thumb');
  if (!b || b.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
  delete b.dataset.step; restThumb(b);
});
const menuButton = document.querySelector('#menu'), closeButton = document.querySelector('#close'), fsButton = document.querySelector('#fullscreen');
if (menuButton) menuButton.onclick = menu;
if (closeButton) closeButton.onclick = close;
async function fullscreen() {
  try {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
    else if (document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
    else fsButton.textContent = '全画面非対応';
  } catch { fsButton.textContent = '全画面非対応'; }
}
if (fsButton) fsButton.onclick = fullscreen;
function cancel() { clearTimeout(timer); held = null; long = false; }
// 横スワイプは段を飛ばして1ページずつ。慣性と、続けて行った操作を区別する。
let wheelTime = -Infinity, wheelDistance = 0, wheelMoved = false;
let wheelPeak = 0, wheelLast = 0, wheelDirection = 0, wheelReverse = 0, wheelMovedAt = -Infinity;
function pageWheel(e) {
  if (e.ctrlKey || (overview && !overview.hidden) || document.body.classList.contains('export')) return;
  if (!e.deltaX || Math.abs(e.deltaX) <= Math.abs(e.deltaY)) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const now = performance.now();
  const dx = e.deltaX * (e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : e.deltaMode === 2 ? innerWidth : 1);
  const strength = Math.abs(dx), direction = Math.sign(dx);
  if (now - wheelTime > 200) {
    wheelDistance = 0; wheelMoved = false; wheelPeak = 0; wheelLast = 0; wheelReverse = 0;
  }
  wheelTime = now;
  if (wheelMoved) {
    if (direction !== wheelDirection) {
      // 小さい揺り戻しは無視し、逆方向の操作が十分に続いたら受け付ける。
      wheelReverse += strength;
      if (wheelReverse < 40) return;
      wheelDistance = direction * wheelReverse;
    } else {
      wheelReverse = 0;
      // 慣性が弱まった後の立ち上がりは、新しいスワイプとして扱う。
      const restarted = now - wheelMovedAt > 120 && wheelLast < wheelPeak * 0.35
        && strength >= Math.max(8, wheelLast * 2);
      wheelPeak = Math.max(wheelPeak, strength); wheelLast = strength;
      if (!restarted) return;
      wheelDistance = dx;
    }
    wheelMoved = false; wheelPeak = 0; wheelReverse = 0;
  } else {
    wheelDistance += dx;
  }
  wheelPeak = Math.max(wheelPeak, strength); wheelLast = strength;
  if (Math.abs(wheelDistance) < 40) return;
  wheelMoved = true; wheelMovedAt = now; wheelDirection = Math.sign(wheelDistance);
  const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, index + Math.sign(wheelDistance)));
  if (target !== index) go(target);
}
addEventListener('wheel', pageWheel, { passive: false, capture: true });
// 図の iframe 内の wheel は親へ伝わらないので、同じジェスチャー状態で扱う。
for (const f of document.querySelectorAll('#stage iframe')) {
  const connect = () => {
    try { f.contentWindow.addEventListener('wheel', pageWheel, { passive: false, capture: true }); }
    catch { /* 別オリジンの図 */ }
  };
  connect(); f.addEventListener('load', connect);
}
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioKeysOff || e.target.closest?.('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]')) return;
  if (overview && !overview.hidden) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' || (e.key === 'o' && !e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey)) close();
    if (e.key === 'Tab') { const items = [...overview.querySelectorAll('button')]; if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items[0]) { e.preventDefault(); items.at(-1).focus(); } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { e.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); } }
    return;
  }
  if (e.target.closest?.('button,a') && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) return;
  if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (held) return; held = e.key; long = false;
    timer = setTimeout(() => { long = true; jump(e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1); }, 450); return;
  }
  if (e.repeat) return;
  if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', ' ', 'Escape', 'o', 'f'].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') go(index + 1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') go(index - 1);
  if (e.key === ' ') move(1);
  if ((e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'o') && overview) menu();
  if (e.key === 'f') fullscreen();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === held) { if (!long) move(e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1); cancel(); } });
addEventListener('blur', cancel); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', cancel);
stage.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioClickOff || e.target.closest('a,button,input') || (overview && !overview.hidden)) return;
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(); move(e.clientX - r.left < r.width * .3 ? -1 : 1);
});
// 図の中で押したキーは図の runtime が親へ送る
addEventListener('message', e => {
  const d = e.data; if (!d || d.channel !== 'slide-studio-figure') return;
  // 枠の高さに合わせて図が縦横比を変えた
  if (d.type === 'ratio') { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('.animation iframe')].find(f => f.contentWindow === e.source); if (f) passRatio(f); return; }
  if (d.type !== 'navigate') return;
  if (d.direction === 'next') move(1); else if (d.direction === 'prev') move(-1);
  else if (d.direction === 'page-next') go(index + 1); else if (d.direction === 'page-prev') go(index - 1);
  else if (d.direction === 'last') jump(1); else if (d.direction === 'first') jump(-1);
});
// 段の最初の step へ（編集画面で段を選んだとき）
function goStage(k, i = index) { const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]); return go(i, t?.start.get(k) ?? 0); }
// 編集用の通し番号。未使用の段は、その位置に挿入したときの開始番号を返す。
function stageNumber(k, i = index) {
  const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]);
  if (!t) return null;
  const next = t.stages.find(s => s >= k);
  return (next == null ? t.count : t.start.get(next)) + 1;
}
window.deck = { go, pageWheel, setFilter, move, jump, maxStep, pdfMarks, pdfSteps, stageAt, stageNumber, goStage, settle, slides, resize, get index() { return index; }, get step() { return step; }, get count() { return slides.length; } };
addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();
// 整数の viewport 寸法が変わらない、小数だけのリサイズも追従する。
if (window.__slideStudioFill && window.frameElement) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(window.frameElement);
const ready = Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(frameReady));
window.deckLoaded = ready;
const domReady = document.readyState === 'loading'
  ? new Promise(resolve => document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve, { once: true })) : Promise.resolve();
domReady.then(() => {
  const m = location.hash.match(/^#(\d+)(?:\/(\d+))?$/);
  return go(m ? Number(m[1]) - 1 : 0);
}).then(() => {
  window.deckReady = true; dispatchEvent(new Event('deckready'));
  // 親 iframe の load は全ページの図を待つため、表示可能になった時点でも知らせる。
  if (parent !== window) parent.postMessage({ channel: 'slide-studio-deck', type: 'ready' }, '*');
});
})();
</script></body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/><title>同期の回帰</title><style id="slide-studio-base">/* 横スワイプでブラウザーの履歴へ移動しない。 */
html, body { overscroll-behavior-x: none; }
/* Slide Studio の基本 CSS（プレイヤーの骨格）。見た目はテーマ（themes/<テーマ>.css）が決める。
   元：quarto-html shared/slides.css。書き出しの HTML にも入る。 */
:root {color-scheme:light; --ink:#182b3a; --accent:#007d88; --muted:#546572}

  --block-quote-width:3.5px;
  --block-bracket-line:3.5px solid #3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-fill:#e6e6efff;
  --block-bracket-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-bracket-radius:0px;
  --block-bracket-shadow:0.18;
  --block-bracket-accent:#3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-width:3.5px;

}
* {box-sizing:border-box} body {margin:0; background:#17232d; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body)}

.section-slide h1 {position:relative} .chapter-number {position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:100%; margin-bottom:.3em; padding-inline:inherit; font-size:.55em; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:.08em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .chapter-number::before {content:attr(data-chapter)}
.slide.cover,.slide.section-slide {padding-top:190px} .cover h2 {border:0; font-size:48px; line-height:1.55} .cover p {color:var(--muted)} .section-slide {background:#e9f2f1} .section-slide h1::before {content:''; display:block; width:70px; height:6px; background:var(--accent); margin-bottom:32px}
iframe {width:100%; height:350px; border:0; display:block; margin:12px 0; pointer-events:none} .columns {display:flex; gap:48px}.column {flex:1; min-width:0} table {border-collapse:collapse; width:auto; max-width:100%; font-size:.85em; margin:24px 0} th,td {padding:15px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #b9c9cd; text-align:left} th {background:#e9f2f1} a {color:inherit} .citation {font-size:.65em; color:var(--muted)}
.citations {position:absolute; bottom:24px; left:64px; right:90px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; color:#53616a; border-top:1px solid #c8d2d4; padding-top:8px}.citations p {font-size:inherit; line-height:inherit; margin:0}.small p,.small {font-size:21px} .page-number {position:absolute; right:30px; bottom:25px; font-size:14px; color:#53616a}
#toolbar {position:fixed; right:0; top:0; padding:12px; display:flex; gap:6px; z-index:5} button {font:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid #c1cbcf; background:#fff; color:#182b3a; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px} button:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #00a2af} #overview {position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:10; overflow:auto; padding:25px; background:#e7ecee} #overview[hidden] {display:none} #overview h2 {font-size:24px; border:0; margin:22px 0 12px} .overview-row {display:flex; gap:12px; overflow-x:auto; padding:6px 2px 14px}.overview-grid {display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px}.thumb {display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; text-align:left; min-width:220px; flex:0 0 260px; padding:8px 8px 10px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.4; border-top:5px solid var(--accent)} .thumb-caption {white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis} .thumb span {font-size:12px; color:#53616a; margin-right:8px}.thumb[aria-current=true] {background:#d7eeeb}
[data-step].pending {visibility:hidden} #help {color:#53616a; font-size:14px} @media(max-width:600px) {#toolbar button {padding:9px 12px} #overview {padding:16px}.overview-grid {grid-template-columns:repeat(4,220px);overflow:auto} .thumb{flex-basis:220px}}
/* 操作のボタンはカーソルを合わせたとき（キーボードでは選んだとき）だけ出す。触る画面では常に出す */
@media(hover:hover) {#toolbar {opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s} #toolbar:hover, #toolbar:has(:focus-visible) {opacity:1}}
/* 一覧の縮小画像（player.js が 1280×720 のページの複製を幅に合わせて縮める） */
.thumb-view {position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:8px; background:var(--paper); outline:1px solid #0000001a; pointer-events:none}
.thumb-steps {position:absolute; left:4px; right:4px; bottom:4px; z-index:1; display:flex; gap:2px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s}
.thumb:hover .thumb-steps, .thumb:focus-visible .thumb-steps, .thumb[aria-current=true] .thumb-steps {opacity:1}
.thumb-steps i {flex:1; height:3px; border-radius:2px; background:#ffffffe6; box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #1e243c59}
.thumb-steps i.on {background:#1F63D6; box-shadow:none}
.thumb-view > .reveal {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:1280px; height:720px; transform:scale(var(--thumb-scale, .2)); transform-origin:top left}
#overview .thumb-view #stage {position:absolute; inset:0; transform:none}
/* チャンクの対応づけ（§7.1）。包みはレイアウトに影響させない */
.slide-studio-c {display:contents}
.slide-studio-missing-cite {color:#b3261e}
.citations .slide-studio-footnote sup {margin-right:4px}
/* 検査・PDF：1280×720 をそのまま左上に置く */
body.export #toolbar {display:none} body.export #stage {left:0!important;top:0!important;transform:none!important}
body.export .highlight {transition:none}
/* 原稿の画像属性。Pandoc は fig-align を data-fig-align として出力する。 */
.slide img[data-fig-align] { display:block; max-width:100%; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="left"] { margin-left:0; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="center"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="right"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:0; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="left"]) { text-align:left; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="center"]) { text-align:center; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="right"]) { text-align:right; }
/* ブロックの内側の余白（§10.4）。初期値は図・画像が0、文字は左右がテーマの --text-pad。
   図・画像は発表の styles/slides.css の変数で全体を、qmd の書き方（図 pad=・画像 style=・段落を包む ::: {style}）で1つだけを変える */
.slide .animation { padding:var(--fig-pad, 0) }
#stage .animation[style*="--fig-ratio"] {
  width:calc(var(--fig-height) * var(--fig-ratio));

/* 文字の色（設計書 §5.6）。qmd には [語]{.accent} のようにテーマの色の名前で書き、色の値はテーマの変数が決める。
   色を付けた中の太字は、太字の色（アクセント）ではなく付けた色にする */

.reveal .result-slot{height:265px;border:2px dashed #b3bdc5;margin:24px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .result-slot strong{font-size:1.1em;color:var(--muted)}

.reveal figure.quarto-float > figcaption{display:none}
.reveal .slide aside.slide-citations {
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:2px;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted);
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:6px;
}
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry { margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;gap:8px; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }

  if (e.key === ' ') move(1);
  if ((e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'o') && overview) menu();
  if (e.key === 'f') fullscreen();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === held) { if (!long) move(e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1); cancel(); } });
addEventListener('blur', cancel); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', cancel);
stage.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioClickOff || e.target.closest('a,button,input') || (overview && !overview.hidden)) return;
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(); move(e.clientX - r.left < r.width * .3 ? -1 : 1);
});
// 図の中で押したキーは図の runtime が親へ送る
addEventListener('message', e => {
  const d = e.data; if (!d || d.channel !== 'slide-studio-figure') return;
  // 枠の高さに合わせて図が縦横比を変えた
  if (d.type === 'ratio') { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('.animation iframe')].find(f => f.contentWindow === e.source); if (f) passRatio(f); return; }
  if (d.type !== 'navigate') return;
  if (d.direction === 'next') move(1); else if (d.direction === 'prev') move(-1);
  else if (d.direction === 'page-next') go(index + 1); else if (d.direction === 'page-prev') go(index - 1);
  else if (d.direction === 'last') jump(1); else if (d.direction === 'first') jump(-1);
});
// 段の最初の step へ（編集画面で段を選んだとき）
function goStage(k, i = index) { const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]); return go(i, t?.start.get(k) ?? 0); }
// 編集用の通し番号。未使用の段は、その位置に挿入したときの開始番号を返す。
function stageNumber(k, i = index) {
  const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]);
  if (!t) return null;
  const next = t.stages.find(s => s >= k);
  return (next == null ? t.count : t.start.get(next)) + 1;
}
window.deck = { go, pageWheel, setFilter, move, jump, maxStep, pdfMarks, pdfSteps, stageAt, stageNumber, goStage, settle, slides, resize, get index() { return index; }, get step() { return step; }, get count() { return slides.length; } };
addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();
// 整数の viewport 寸法が変わらない、小数だけのリサイズも追従する。
if (window.__slideStudioFill && window.frameElement) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(window.frameElement);
const ready = Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(frameReady));
window.deckLoaded = ready;
const domReady = document.readyState === 'loading'
  ? new Promise(resolve => document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve, { once: true })) : Promise.resolve();
domReady.then(() => {
  const m = location.hash.match(/^#(\d+)(?:\/(\d+))?$/);
  return go(m ? Number(m[1]) - 1 : 0);
}).then(() => {
  window.deckReady = true; dispatchEvent(new Event('deckready'));
  // 親 iframe の load は全ページの図を待つため、表示可能になった時点でも知らせる。
  if (parent !== window) parent.postMessage({ channel: 'slide-studio-deck', type: 'ready' }, '*');
});
})();
</script></body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/><title>同期の回帰</title><style id="slide-studio-base">/* 横スワイプでブラウザーの履歴へ移動しない。 */
html, body { overscroll-behavior-x: none; }
/* Slide Studio の基本 CSS（プレイヤーの骨格）。見た目はテーマ（themes/<テーマ>.css）が決める。
   元：quarto-html shared/slides.css。書き出しの HTML にも入る。 */
:root {color-scheme:light; --ink:#182b3a; --accent:#007d88; --muted:#546572}
/* 旧「影付き」「二色ライン」の原稿を引き続き表示するための変数。 */
:root { --block-shadow-fill:#edf6faff; --block-shadow-color:#65758b55;
  --block-corner-top:4px solid var(--accent); --block-corner-left:4px solid #7d739eff; --block-corner-fill:#edf6faff }
/* block palette v4: 整理・結論・補足・引用・定義・メモ */
:root {
  --block-border:3.5px solid #7b848fff;
  --block-background:#ffffffff;
  --block-plain-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-plain-radius:10px;
  --block-plain-shadow:0.18;
  --block-top-line:8px solid #2167a8ff;
  --block-top-fill:#e0e8f0ff;
  --block-top-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-top-radius:10px;
  --block-top-shadow:0.18;
  --block-left-line:10px solid #27804fff;
  --block-left-fill:#daece2ff;
  --block-left-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-left-radius:10px;
  --block-left-shadow:0.18;
  --block-quote-line:3.5px solid #667483ff;
  --block-quote-fill:#e5e8ebff;
  --block-quote-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-quote-radius:10px;
  --block-quote-shadow:0.18;
  --block-quote-accent:#667483ff;
  --block-quote-width:3.5px;
  --block-bracket-line:3.5px solid #3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-fill:#e6e6efff;
  --block-bracket-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-bracket-radius:0px;
  --block-bracket-shadow:0.18;
  --block-bracket-accent:#3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-width:3.5px;
  --block-fold-line:3.5px solid #ab7b17ff;
  --block-fold-fill:#ede7d9ff;
  --block-fold-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-fold-radius:10px;
  --block-fold-shadow:0.18;
  --block-fold-accent:#ab7b17ff;
  --block-fold-width:3.5px;
  --block-unframed-radius:0px; --block-unframed-shadow:0.18;
}
* {box-sizing:border-box} body {margin:0; background:#17232d; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body)}
#stage {position:fixed; width:1280px; height:720px; transform-origin:top left; background:var(--paper)}
.slide {position:absolute; inset:0; padding:48px 64px 94px; display:none; overflow:hidden; background:var(--paper)}
.slide.active {display:block} h1,h2,h3,p {margin:0} h2 {font-size:38px; line-height:1.35; margin-bottom:28px; border-bottom:3px solid var(--accent); padding-bottom:14px} h1 {font-size:62px} h3 {font-size:28px; margin:22px 0 12px} p,li {font-size:27px; line-height:1.65} p {margin:14px 0} li {margin:12px 0} ul {padding-left:1.2em} strong {color:var(--accent)}
.section-slide h1 {position:relative} .chapter-number {position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:100%; margin-bottom:.3em; padding-inline:inherit; font-size:.55em; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:.08em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .chapter-number::before {content:attr(data-chapter)}
.slide.cover,.slide.section-slide {padding-top:190px} .cover h2 {border:0; font-size:48px; line-height:1.55} .cover p {color:var(--muted)} .section-slide {background:#e9f2f1} .section-slide h1::before {content:''; display:block; width:70px; height:6px; background:var(--accent); margin-bottom:32px}
iframe {width:100%; height:350px; border:0; display:block; margin:12px 0; pointer-events:none} .columns {display:flex; gap:48px}.column {flex:1; min-width:0} table {border-collapse:collapse; width:auto; max-width:100%; font-size:.85em; margin:24px 0} th,td {padding:15px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #b9c9cd; text-align:left} th {background:#e9f2f1} a {color:inherit} .citation {font-size:.65em; color:var(--muted)}
.citations {position:absolute; bottom:24px; left:64px; right:90px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; color:#53616a; border-top:1px solid #c8d2d4; padding-top:8px}.citations p {font-size:inherit; line-height:inherit; margin:0}.small p,.small {font-size:21px} .page-number {position:absolute; right:30px; bottom:25px; font-size:14px; color:#53616a}
#toolbar {position:fixed; right:0; top:0; padding:12px; display:flex; gap:6px; z-index:5} button {font:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid #c1cbcf; background:#fff; color:#182b3a; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px} button:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #00a2af} #overview {position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:10; overflow:auto; padding:25px; background:#e7ecee} #overview[hidden] {display:none} #overview h2 {font-size:24px; border:0; margin:22px 0 12px} .overview-row {display:flex; gap:12px; overflow-x:auto; padding:6px 2px 14px}.overview-grid {display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px}.thumb {display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; text-align:left; min-width:220px; flex:0 0 260px; padding:8px 8px 10px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.4; border-top:5px solid var(--accent)} .thumb-caption {white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis} .thumb span {font-size:12px; color:#53616a; margin-right:8px}.thumb[aria-current=true] {background:#d7eeeb}
[data-step].pending {visibility:hidden} #help {color:#53616a; font-size:14px} @media(max-width:600px) {#toolbar button {padding:9px 12px} #overview {padding:16px}.overview-grid {grid-template-columns:repeat(4,220px);overflow:auto} .thumb{flex-basis:220px}}
/* 操作のボタンはカーソルを合わせたとき（キーボードでは選んだとき）だけ出す。触る画面では常に出す */
@media(hover:hover) {#toolbar {opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s} #toolbar:hover, #toolbar:has(:focus-visible) {opacity:1}}
/* 一覧の縮小画像（player.js が 1280×720 のページの複製を幅に合わせて縮める） */
.thumb-view {position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:8px; background:var(--paper); outline:1px solid #0000001a; pointer-events:none}
.thumb-steps {position:absolute; left:4px; right:4px; bottom:4px; z-index:1; display:flex; gap:2px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s}
.thumb:hover .thumb-steps, .thumb:focus-visible .thumb-steps, .thumb[aria-current=true] .thumb-steps {opacity:1}
.thumb-steps i {flex:1; height:3px; border-radius:2px; background:#ffffffe6; box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #1e243c59}
.thumb-steps i.on {background:#1F63D6; box-shadow:none}
.thumb-view > .reveal {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:1280px; height:720px; transform:scale(var(--thumb-scale, .2)); transform-origin:top left}
#overview .thumb-view #stage {position:absolute; inset:0; transform:none}
/* チャンクの対応づけ（§7.1）。包みはレイアウトに影響させない */
.slide-studio-c {display:contents}
.slide-studio-missing-cite {color:#b3261e}
.citations .slide-studio-footnote sup {margin-right:4px}
/* 検査・PDF：1280×720 をそのまま左上に置く */
body.export #toolbar {display:none} body.export #stage {left:0!important;top:0!important;transform:none!important}
body.export .highlight {transition:none}
/* 原稿の画像属性。Pandoc は fig-align を data-fig-align として出力する。 */
.slide img[data-fig-align] { display:block; max-width:100%; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="left"] { margin-left:0; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="center"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="right"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:0; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="left"]) { text-align:left; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="center"]) { text-align:center; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="right"]) { text-align:right; }
/* ブロックの内側の余白（§10.4）。初期値は図・画像が0、文字は左右がテーマの --text-pad。
   図・画像は発表の styles/slides.css の変数で全体を、qmd の書き方（図 pad=・画像 style=・段落を包む ::: {style}）で1つだけを変える */
.slide .animation { padding:var(--fig-pad, 0) }
#stage .animation[style*="--fig-ratio"] {
  width:calc(var(--fig-height) * var(--fig-ratio));
  max-width:100%;
  height:auto!important;
  aspect-ratio:var(--fig-ratio);
}
.slide img { padding:var(--img-pad, 0) }
#stage .slide div[style*="padding"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote) { padding:0 }
#stage .slide div[style*="padding"] > :is(ul,ol) { padding-right:0; padding-block:0 }
/* 文字のバッファを調整した包み。行間は保ち、先頭・末尾の余白は padding だけにする。
   text-box は包みから最初・最後の行へ伝わり、配布 HTML/PDF も同じ配置になる。 */
#stage .slide div[style*="text-box:"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote,ul,ol):first-child { margin-top:0 }
#stage .slide div[style*="text-box:"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote,ul,ol):last-child { margin-bottom:0 }
/* 文字の色（設計書 §5.6）。qmd には [語]{.accent} のようにテーマの色の名前で書き、色の値はテーマの変数が決める。
   色を付けた中の太字は、太字の色（アクセント）ではなく付けた色にする */
.slide .accent {color:var(--accent)} .slide .main {color:var(--header)} .slide .muted {color:var(--muted)} .slide .warn {color:var(--warn)} .slide .good {color:var(--good)}
.slide :is(.accent,.main,.muted,.warn,.good,.highlight,span[style*="color"]) :is(strong,b) {color:inherit}
/* 段の無いマーカー（書式バーで付けたもの）は最初から塗る */
.slide .highlight:not([data-highlight-step]) {background:var(--mark);color:var(--mark-ink)}

/* 共通の骨格（旧 default.css から移動）。 */
.reveal .slides{text-align:left}
.reveal p{line-height:1.65;margin:14px 0}
.reveal .lead{font-size:1.02em;margin:4px 0 10px}
.reveal .small,.reveal .source{font-size:.55em;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.reveal .source{margin-top:8px}
.reveal .static-figure{display:block;width:100%;height:370px;object-fit:contain;margin:8px 0}
.animation{height:450px;position:relative}
/* 図の枠の角は、図の runtime（figure.mjs の BUFFER）が描いた範囲の外に残すバッファと同じだけ丸める */
.animation iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1;opacity:0}
.animation.loaded iframe{opacity:1}
.fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--paper)}
.fallback img{width:100%;height:350px;object-fit:contain;margin:0!important}
.fallback p{font-size:16px!important}
.loaded .fallback{display:none}
.print-scenes{display:none}
.animation-cues{position:relative;height:0;font-size:23px;color:var(--accent)}
.animation-cues .fragment{position:absolute;inset:0}
.reveal .result-slot{height:265px;border:2px dashed #b3bdc5;margin:24px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .result-slot strong{font-size:1.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .result-slot p{font-size:.62em}
.reveal ul{line-height:1.8}
.reveal .notes{display:none}
.reveal .slides section{height:100%}
.reveal .references{font-size:.7em;line-height:1.65}
.reveal .references li{margin-bottom:18px}
.print-pdf .animation,.print-pdf .animation-cues{display:none!important}
.print-pdf .print-scenes{display:flex!important;gap:10px;height:390px;align-items:center}
.print-scenes img{width:32%;max-height:360px;object-fit:contain}
.print-scenes figure{width:33%;margin:0}
.print-scenes figure img{width:100%}
.print-scenes figcaption{font-size:14px}
@media print{.animation,.animation-cues{display:none!important}.print-scenes{display:flex!important;gap:10px}.print-scenes figure{width:33%}}
.reveal figure.quarto-float > figcaption{display:none}
.reveal .slide aside.slide-citations {
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:2px;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted);
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:6px;
}
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry { margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;gap:8px; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-left-margin { flex:0 0 auto; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-right-inline { margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.reveal #refs { font-size:23px;line-height:1.5; }
.reveal #refs .csl-entry { margin-bottom:22px; }
.reveal #refs .csl-right-inline { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.reveal figure figcaption{display:none}
.print-scenes figure:only-child{width:100%}
.print-scenes figure:only-child img{max-height:390px;width:100%}
.reveal section.cover h2{display:none}
.print-scenes figure{flex:1;width:0}
.reveal .footnote-small{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:12px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .footnote-small p{margin:0}
.reveal .math{font-family:"Times New Roman",Times,serif;font-size:1.08em}
.reveal .math sub,.reveal .math sup{font-size:.68em}
.print-pdf .reveal .slides section.slide::after{bottom:60px}
@media print{.reveal .slides section.slide::after{bottom:60px}}
.reveal .has-citations .footnote-small{position:static;margin-top:10px}
.reveal .slides section.slide{
  --content-inset:44px;
  --gutter:22px;
  --text-pad:12px;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-inline:var(--content-inset);
}
.reveal .slides section.slide > h2{
  margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--content-inset));
  padding-left:calc(20px + .5em);
}
.reveal .slide aside.slide-citations,
.reveal .slide .footnote-small{
  left:var(--content-inset);right:var(--content-inset);
}
.slide-menu-button{display:none!important}
.reveal .slide-shortcuts{
  position:absolute;right:24px;bottom:16px;z-index:20;
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:4px 16px;
  max-width:calc(100% - 150px);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;
  color:var(--muted);pointer-events:none;
}
.reveal .slide-shortcuts span{white-space:nowrap}
.reveal.overview .slide-shortcuts,.print-pdf .slide-shortcuts{display:none}
@media print{.reveal .slide-shortcuts{display:none}}
@media screen{
  .reveal.overview .slides{
    display:grid!important;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--overview-columns),minmax(0,1fr));
    gap:24px;align-content:start;
    position:absolute;inset:0!important;
    width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
    padding:32px;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0!important;
    transform:none!important;zoom:1!important;
    overflow:auto!important;scrollbar-gutter:stable;
  }
  .reveal.overview .slides section.slide{
    display:block!important;position:relative!important;
    top:0!important;left:0!important;margin:0!important;
    width:var(--overview-width)!important;height:var(--overview-height)!important;
    min-height:0!important;transform:none!important;
    zoom:var(--overview-scale);opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;
    background:var(--paper);outline:5px solid #c3cfda;outline-offset:0;
    cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .reveal.overview .slides section.slide.present,
  .reveal.overview .slides section.slide:hover{outline-color:var(--accent)}
  .reveal.overview .slides section.slide *{pointer-events:none!important}
  .reveal.overview .backgrounds,.reveal.overview .slide-number,
  .reveal.overview .progress{display:none!important}
}
body{background:var(--paper)}
#stage{background:var(--paper)}
#stage .slide{padding:0 var(--content-inset);overflow:visible;background:var(--paper)}
#stage h1,#stage h2,#stage h3{margin-top:0;font-family:var(--font-head)}
#stage p,#stage li{font-size:inherit}
#stage li{margin:0}
#stage ul,#stage ol{margin:0 0 0 1em;padding:0;line-height:1.8}
#stage .slide :is(p,ul,ol,h3,h4,blockquote):not(li *){padding-inline:var(--text-pad)}
/* 黒丸の幅はブロックの箱の内側に取る（選択の枠が黒丸も囲む）。padding は余白のつまみが書き換えるので li の margin にする */
#stage .slide :is(ul,ol):not(li *,.toc-list){margin-left:0}
#stage .slide :is(ul,ol):not(li *,.toc-list) > li{margin-left:1em}
#stage .columns{display:flex;gap:var(--gutter)}
#stage .column{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}
#stage .column:has(.animation[style*='--fig-ratio']){flex:0 1 auto}
#stage .column:not(:has(.animation)){min-width:15em}
#stage .column[style*='width']{flex:0 1 auto}
#stage .animation{aspect-ratio:var(--fig-ratio,auto);max-width:100%;margin-inline:auto}
#stage iframe{height:100%;max-height:100%;margin:0;border:0;width:100%;max-width:100%}
#stage .cover h2{display:none}
#stage .cover-title{font-size:1.9em;line-height:1.5;margin-top:56px}
/* 表紙はタイトル → 副題 → 発表者の順に通常フローで積む。子の余白を外へ逃がさない。 */
#stage .cover-title{display:flow-root}
#stage .cover-title p{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;margin:0}
#stage .cover-subtitle{display:flow-root;margin-top:0}
#stage .cover-subtitle p{margin:0}
/* 表紙の発表者と所属（cover.py）。色・字間はテーマの .cover p に任せ、大きさだけ決める */
#stage .cover .cover-authors{margin-top:44px}
#stage .cover .cover-authors p{margin:0;line-height:1.6}
#stage .cover .cover-names,#stage .cover .cover-name{font-size:35px}
#stage .cover .cover-affiliations,#stage .cover .cover-author .cover-affiliation{font-size:35px}
#stage .cover .cover-affiliations{margin-top:6px}
#stage .cover .cover-names .cover-author+.cover-author,#stage .cover .cover-affiliation+.cover-affiliation{margin-left:1.2em}
#stage .cover .cover-authors sup{font-size:.6em;margin-left:.15em;line-height:0}
#stage .cover .cover-affiliations sup{margin:0 .25em 0 0}
#stage .cover .each .cover-author{display:inline-block;vertical-align:top;margin-right:1.6em;font-size:1em}

}

    const reveal = document.createElement('div'); reveal.className = 'reveal';
    const copy = document.createElement('div'); copy.id = 'stage'; copy.className = 'slides';

    copy.append(s); reveal.append(copy); view.append(reveal, bar); b.prepend(view); fit.observe(view);

  const b = e.target.closest('.thumb'); if (!b) return;

function cancel() { clearTimeout(timer); held = null; long = false; }
// 横スワイプは段を飛ばして1ページずつ。慣性と、続けて行った操作を区別する。
let wheelTime = -Infinity, wheelDistance = 0, wheelMoved = false;

    if (e.key === 'Tab') { const items = [...overview.querySelectorAll('button')]; if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items[0]) { e.preventDefault(); items.at(-1).focus(); } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { e.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); } }
    return;

  if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;

  }
  if (e.repeat) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') go(index + 1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') go(index - 1);

addEventListener('blur', cancel); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', cancel);
stage.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioClickOff || e.target.closest('a,button,input') || (overview && !overview.hidden)) return;

function goStage(k, i = index) { const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]); return go(i, t?.start.get(k) ?? 0); }

if (window.__slideStudioFill && window.frameElement) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(window.frameElement);
const ready = Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(frameReady));
window.deckLoaded = ready;
const domReady = document.readyState === 'loading'
  ? new Promise(resolve => document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve, { once: true })) : Promise.resolve();

  const m = location.hash.match(/^#(\d+)(?:\/(\d+))?$/);

</script></body></html>

/* 文字のバッファを調整した包み。行間は保ち、先頭・末尾の余白は padding だけにする。

#stage :is([style*="--block-design:bracket"], [style*="--block-design: bracket"]) { --bd-radius:var(--block-bracket-radius); --bd-shadow:var(--block-bracket-shadow); position:relative; border:0 solid transparent; border-radius:var(--bd-radius); background-color:var(--block-bracket-fill); color:var(--block-bracket-ink); }

    copies.set(b, partsOf(s));
    s.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f => {
      f.loading = 'lazy'; f.tabIndex = -1;
      frameReady(f).then(() => {
        const a = anim(f); if (!a) return;
        a.setVisible?.(true); restThumb(b);
        return Promise.resolve(a.settled).then(() => passRatio(f));
      });
    });
    const view = document.createElement('div'); view.className = 'thumb-view'; view.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    const reveal = document.createElement('div'); reveal.className = 'reveal';
    const copy = document.createElement('div'); copy.id = 'stage'; copy.className = 'slides';
    const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'thumb-steps';
    copy.append(s); reveal.append(copy); view.append(reveal, bar); b.prepend(view); fit.observe(view);
    restThumb(b);
  });
}
overview?.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.thumb'); if (!b) return;
  const n = maxStep(+b.dataset.index) + 1; if (n < 2) return;
  const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(), k = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * n)));
  if (b.dataset.step !== String(k)) { b.dataset.step = k; showThumb(b, k); }
});
overview?.addEventListener('pointerout', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('.thumb');
  if (!b || b.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
  delete b.dataset.step; restThumb(b);
});
const menuButton = document.querySelector('#menu'), closeButton = document.querySelector('#close'), fsButton = document.querySelector('#fullscreen');
if (menuButton) menuButton.onclick = menu;
if (closeButton) closeButton.onclick = close;
async function fullscreen() {
  try {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
    else if (document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
    else fsButton.textContent = '全画面非対応';
  } catch { fsButton.textContent = '全画面非対応'; }
}
if (fsButton) fsButton.onclick = fullscreen;
function cancel() { clearTimeout(timer); held = null; long = false; }
// 横スワイプは段を飛ばして1ページずつ。慣性と、続けて行った操作を区別する。
let wheelTime = -Infinity, wheelDistance = 0, wheelMoved = false;
let wheelPeak = 0, wheelLast = 0, wheelDirection = 0, wheelReverse = 0, wheelMovedAt = -Infinity;
function pageWheel(e) {
  if (e.ctrlKey || (overview && !overview.hidden) || document.body.classList.contains('export')) return;
  if (!e.deltaX || Math.abs(e.deltaX) <= Math.abs(e.deltaY)) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const now = performance.now();
  const dx = e.deltaX * (e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : e.deltaMode === 2 ? innerWidth : 1);
  const strength = Math.abs(dx), direction = Math.sign(dx);
  if (now - wheelTime > 200) {
    wheelDistance = 0; wheelMoved = false; wheelPeak = 0; wheelLast = 0; wheelReverse = 0;
  }
  wheelTime = now;
  if (wheelMoved) {
    if (direction !== wheelDirection) {
      // 小さい揺り戻しは無視し、逆方向の操作が十分に続いたら受け付ける。
      wheelReverse += strength;
      if (wheelReverse < 40) return;
      wheelDistance = direction * wheelReverse;
    } else {
      wheelReverse = 0;
      // 慣性が弱まった後の立ち上がりは、新しいスワイプとして扱う。
      const restarted = now - wheelMovedAt > 120 && wheelLast < wheelPeak * 0.35
        && strength >= Math.max(8, wheelLast * 2);
      wheelPeak = Math.max(wheelPeak, strength); wheelLast = strength;
      if (!restarted) return;
      wheelDistance = dx;
    }
    wheelMoved = false; wheelPeak = 0; wheelReverse = 0;
  } else {
    wheelDistance += dx;
  }
  wheelPeak = Math.max(wheelPeak, strength); wheelLast = strength;
  if (Math.abs(wheelDistance) < 40) return;
  wheelMoved = true; wheelMovedAt = now; wheelDirection = Math.sign(wheelDistance);
  const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, index + Math.sign(wheelDistance)));
  if (target !== index) go(target);
}
addEventListener('wheel', pageWheel, { passive: false, capture: true });
// 図の iframe 内の wheel は親へ伝わらないので、同じジェスチャー状態で扱う。
for (const f of document.querySelectorAll('#stage iframe')) {
  const connect = () => {
    try { f.contentWindow.addEventListener('wheel', pageWheel, { passive: false, capture: true }); }
    catch { /* 別オリジンの図 */ }
  };
  connect(); f.addEventListener('load', connect);
}
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioKeysOff || e.target.closest?.('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]')) return;
  if (overview && !overview.hidden) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' || (e.key === 'o' && !e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey)) close();
    if (e.key === 'Tab') { const items = [...overview.querySelectorAll('button')]; if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items[0]) { e.preventDefault(); items.at(-1).focus(); } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === items.at(-1)) { e.preventDefault(); items[0].focus(); } }
    return;
  }
  if (e.target.closest?.('button,a') && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) return;
  if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (held) return; held = e.key; long = false;
    timer = setTimeout(() => { long = true; jump(e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1); }, 450); return;
  }
  if (e.repeat) return;
  if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', ' ', 'Escape', 'o', 'f'].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') go(index + 1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') go(index - 1);
  if (e.key === ' ') move(1);
  if ((e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'o') && overview) menu();
  if (e.key === 'f') fullscreen();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === held) { if (!long) move(e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1); cancel(); } });
addEventListener('blur', cancel); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', cancel);
stage.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (window.__slideStudioClickOff || e.target.closest('a,button,input') || (overview && !overview.hidden)) return;
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(); move(e.clientX - r.left < r.width * .3 ? -1 : 1);
});
// 図の中で押したキーは図の runtime が親へ送る
addEventListener('message', e => {
  const d = e.data; if (!d || d.channel !== 'slide-studio-figure') return;
  // 枠の高さに合わせて図が縦横比を変えた
  if (d.type === 'ratio') { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('.animation iframe')].find(f => f.contentWindow === e.source); if (f) passRatio(f); return; }
  if (d.type !== 'navigate') return;
  if (d.direction === 'next') move(1); else if (d.direction === 'prev') move(-1);
  else if (d.direction === 'page-next') go(index + 1); else if (d.direction === 'page-prev') go(index - 1);
  else if (d.direction === 'last') jump(1); else if (d.direction === 'first') jump(-1);
});
// 段の最初の step へ（編集画面で段を選んだとき）
function goStage(k, i = index) { const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]); return go(i, t?.start.get(k) ?? 0); }
// 編集用の通し番号。未使用の段は、その位置に挿入したときの開始番号を返す。
function stageNumber(k, i = index) {
  const t = slides[i] && timeline(slides[i]);
  if (!t) return null;
  const next = t.stages.find(s => s >= k);
  return (next == null ? t.count : t.start.get(next)) + 1;
}
window.deck = { go, pageWheel, setFilter, move, jump, maxStep, pdfMarks, pdfSteps, stageAt, stageNumber, goStage, settle, slides, resize, get index() { return index; }, get step() { return step; }, get count() { return slides.length; } };
addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();
// 整数の viewport 寸法が変わらない、小数だけのリサイズも追従する。
if (window.__slideStudioFill && window.frameElement) new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(window.frameElement);
const ready = Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(frameReady));
window.deckLoaded = ready;
const domReady = document.readyState === 'loading'
  ? new Promise(resolve => document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve, { once: true })) : Promise.resolve();
domReady.then(() => {
  const m = location.hash.match(/^#(\d+)(?:\/(\d+))?$/);
  return go(m ? Number(m[1]) - 1 : 0);
}).then(() => {
  window.deckReady = true; dispatchEvent(new Event('deckready'));
  // 親 iframe の load は全ページの図を待つため、表示可能になった時点でも知らせる。
  if (parent !== window) parent.postMessage({ channel: 'slide-studio-deck', type: 'ready' }, '*');
});
})();
</script></body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/><title>同期の回帰</title><style id="slide-studio-base">/* 横スワイプでブラウザーの履歴へ移動しない。 */
html, body { overscroll-behavior-x: none; }
/* Slide Studio の基本 CSS（プレイヤーの骨格）。見た目はテーマ（themes/<テーマ>.css）が決める。
   元：quarto-html shared/slides.css。書き出しの HTML にも入る。 */
:root {color-scheme:light; --ink:#182b3a; --accent:#007d88; --muted:#546572}
/* 旧「影付き」「二色ライン」の原稿を引き続き表示するための変数。 */
:root { --block-shadow-fill:#edf6faff; --block-shadow-color:#65758b55;
  --block-corner-top:4px solid var(--accent); --block-corner-left:4px solid #7d739eff; --block-corner-fill:#edf6faff }
/* block palette v4: 整理・結論・補足・引用・定義・メモ */
:root {
  --block-border:3.5px solid #7b848fff;
  --block-background:#ffffffff;
  --block-plain-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-plain-radius:10px;
  --block-plain-shadow:0.18;
  --block-top-line:8px solid #2167a8ff;
  --block-top-fill:#e0e8f0ff;
  --block-top-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-top-radius:10px;
  --block-top-shadow:0.18;
  --block-left-line:10px solid #27804fff;
  --block-left-fill:#daece2ff;
  --block-left-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-left-radius:10px;
  --block-left-shadow:0.18;
  --block-quote-line:3.5px solid #667483ff;
  --block-quote-fill:#e5e8ebff;
  --block-quote-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-quote-radius:10px;
  --block-quote-shadow:0.18;
  --block-quote-accent:#667483ff;
  --block-quote-width:3.5px;
  --block-bracket-line:3.5px solid #3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-fill:#e6e6efff;
  --block-bracket-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-bracket-radius:0px;
  --block-bracket-shadow:0.18;
  --block-bracket-accent:#3f3d85ff;
  --block-bracket-width:3.5px;
  --block-fold-line:3.5px solid #ab7b17ff;
  --block-fold-fill:#ede7d9ff;
  --block-fold-ink:#233244ff;
  --block-fold-radius:10px;
  --block-fold-shadow:0.18;
  --block-fold-accent:#ab7b17ff;
  --block-fold-width:3.5px;
  --block-unframed-radius:0px; --block-unframed-shadow:0.18;
}
* {box-sizing:border-box} body {margin:0; background:#17232d; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-body)}
#stage {position:fixed; width:1280px; height:720px; transform-origin:top left; background:var(--paper)}
.slide {position:absolute; inset:0; padding:48px 64px 94px; display:none; overflow:hidden; background:var(--paper)}
.slide.active {display:block} h1,h2,h3,p {margin:0} h2 {font-size:38px; line-height:1.35; margin-bottom:28px; border-bottom:3px solid var(--accent); padding-bottom:14px} h1 {font-size:62px} h3 {font-size:28px; margin:22px 0 12px} p,li {font-size:27px; line-height:1.65} p {margin:14px 0} li {margin:12px 0} ul {padding-left:1.2em} strong {color:var(--accent)}
.section-slide h1 {position:relative} .chapter-number {position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:100%; margin-bottom:.3em; padding-inline:inherit; font-size:.55em; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:.08em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .chapter-number::before {content:attr(data-chapter)}
.slide.cover,.slide.section-slide {padding-top:190px} .cover h2 {border:0; font-size:48px; line-height:1.55} .cover p {color:var(--muted)} .section-slide {background:#e9f2f1} .section-slide h1::before {content:''; display:block; width:70px; height:6px; background:var(--accent); margin-bottom:32px}
iframe {width:100%; height:350px; border:0; display:block; margin:12px 0; pointer-events:none} .columns {display:flex; gap:48px}.column {flex:1; min-width:0} table {border-collapse:collapse; width:auto; max-width:100%; font-size:.85em; margin:24px 0} th,td {padding:15px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #b9c9cd; text-align:left} th {background:#e9f2f1} a {color:inherit} .citation {font-size:.65em; color:var(--muted)}
.citations {position:absolute; bottom:24px; left:64px; right:90px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; color:#53616a; border-top:1px solid #c8d2d4; padding-top:8px}.citations p {font-size:inherit; line-height:inherit; margin:0}.small p,.small {font-size:21px} .page-number {position:absolute; right:30px; bottom:25px; font-size:14px; color:#53616a}
#toolbar {position:fixed; right:0; top:0; padding:12px; display:flex; gap:6px; z-index:5} button {font:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid #c1cbcf; background:#fff; color:#182b3a; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px} button:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #00a2af} #overview {position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:10; overflow:auto; padding:25px; background:#e7ecee} #overview[hidden] {display:none} #overview h2 {font-size:24px; border:0; margin:22px 0 12px} .overview-row {display:flex; gap:12px; overflow-x:auto; padding:6px 2px 14px}.overview-grid {display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px}.thumb {display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-start; text-align:left; min-width:220px; flex:0 0 260px; padding:8px 8px 10px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.4; border-top:5px solid var(--accent)} .thumb-caption {white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis} .thumb span {font-size:12px; color:#53616a; margin-right:8px}.thumb[aria-current=true] {background:#d7eeeb}
[data-step].pending {visibility:hidden} #help {color:#53616a; font-size:14px} @media(max-width:600px) {#toolbar button {padding:9px 12px} #overview {padding:16px}.overview-grid {grid-template-columns:repeat(4,220px);overflow:auto} .thumb{flex-basis:220px}}
/* 操作のボタンはカーソルを合わせたとき（キーボードでは選んだとき）だけ出す。触る画面では常に出す */
@media(hover:hover) {#toolbar {opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s} #toolbar:hover, #toolbar:has(:focus-visible) {opacity:1}}
/* 一覧の縮小画像（player.js が 1280×720 のページの複製を幅に合わせて縮める） */
.thumb-view {position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:8px; background:var(--paper); outline:1px solid #0000001a; pointer-events:none}
.thumb-steps {position:absolute; left:4px; right:4px; bottom:4px; z-index:1; display:flex; gap:2px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .15s}
.thumb:hover .thumb-steps, .thumb:focus-visible .thumb-steps, .thumb[aria-current=true] .thumb-steps {opacity:1}
.thumb-steps i {flex:1; height:3px; border-radius:2px; background:#ffffffe6; box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px #1e243c59}
.thumb-steps i.on {background:#1F63D6; box-shadow:none}
.thumb-view > .reveal {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:1280px; height:720px; transform:scale(var(--thumb-scale, .2)); transform-origin:top left}
#overview .thumb-view #stage {position:absolute; inset:0; transform:none}
/* チャンクの対応づけ（§7.1）。包みはレイアウトに影響させない */
.slide-studio-c {display:contents}
.slide-studio-missing-cite {color:#b3261e}
.citations .slide-studio-footnote sup {margin-right:4px}
/* 検査・PDF：1280×720 をそのまま左上に置く */
body.export #toolbar {display:none} body.export #stage {left:0!important;top:0!important;transform:none!important}
body.export .highlight {transition:none}
/* 原稿の画像属性。Pandoc は fig-align を data-fig-align として出力する。 */
.slide img[data-fig-align] { display:block; max-width:100%; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="left"] { margin-left:0; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="center"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; }
.slide img[data-fig-align="right"] { margin-left:auto; margin-right:0; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="left"]) { text-align:left; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="center"]) { text-align:center; }
.slide figure:has(> img[data-fig-align="right"]) { text-align:right; }
/* ブロックの内側の余白（§10.4）。初期値は図・画像が0、文字は左右がテーマの --text-pad。
   図・画像は発表の styles/slides.css の変数で全体を、qmd の書き方（図 pad=・画像 style=・段落を包む ::: {style}）で1つだけを変える */
.slide .animation { padding:var(--fig-pad, 0) }
#stage .animation[style*="--fig-ratio"] {
  width:calc(var(--fig-height) * var(--fig-ratio));
  max-width:100%;
  height:auto!important;
  aspect-ratio:var(--fig-ratio);
}
.slide img { padding:var(--img-pad, 0) }
#stage .slide div[style*="padding"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote) { padding:0 }
#stage .slide div[style*="padding"] > :is(ul,ol) { padding-right:0; padding-block:0 }
/* 文字のバッファを調整した包み。行間は保ち、先頭・末尾の余白は padding だけにする。
   text-box は包みから最初・最後の行へ伝わり、配布 HTML/PDF も同じ配置になる。 */
#stage .slide div[style*="text-box:"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote,ul,ol):first-child { margin-top:0 }
#stage .slide div[style*="text-box:"] > :is(p,h3,h4,blockquote,ul,ol):last-child { margin-bottom:0 }
/* 文字の色（設計書 §5.6）。qmd には [語]{.accent} のようにテーマの色の名前で書き、色の値はテーマの変数が決める。
   色を付けた中の太字は、太字の色（アクセント）ではなく付けた色にする */
.slide .accent {color:var(--accent)} .slide .main {color:var(--header)} .slide .muted {color:var(--muted)} .slide .warn {color:var(--warn)} .slide .good {color:var(--good)}

/* 段の無いマーカー（書式バーで付けたもの）は最初から塗る */

/* 共通の骨格（旧 default.css から移動）。 */
.reveal .slides{text-align:left}
.reveal p{line-height:1.65;margin:14px 0}
.reveal .lead{font-size:1.02em;margin:4px 0 10px}

.animation{height:450px;position:relative}
/* 図の枠の角は、図の runtime（figure.mjs の BUFFER）が描いた範囲の外に残すバッファと同じだけ丸める */
.animation iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1;opacity:0}
.animation.loaded iframe{opacity:1}
.fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--paper)}

.loaded .fallback{display:none}
.print-scenes{display:none}

.animation-cues .fragment{position:absolute;inset:0}
.reveal .result-slot{height:265px;border:2px dashed #b3bdc5;margin:24px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .result-slot strong{font-size:1.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal .result-slot p{font-size:.62em}
.reveal ul{line-height:1.8}
.reveal .notes{display:none}
.reveal .slides section{height:100%}
.reveal .references{font-size:.7em;line-height:1.65}
.reveal .references li{margin-bottom:18px}
.print-pdf .animation,.print-pdf .animation-cues{display:none!important}
.print-pdf .print-scenes{display:flex!important;gap:10px;height:390px;align-items:center}
.print-scenes img{width:32%;max-height:360px;object-fit:contain}

@media print{.animation,.animation-cues{display:none!important}.print-scenes{display:flex!important;gap:10px}.print-scenes figure{width:33%}}
.reveal figure.quarto-float > figcaption{display:none}
.reveal .slide aside.slide-citations {
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:2px;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted);
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:6px;
}
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry { margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;gap:8px; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-entry:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.reveal .slide-citations .csl-left-margin { flex:0 0 auto; }

.reveal #refs .csl-right-inline { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }

.print-scenes figure{flex:1;width:0}
